result.instructions: Tools for sanctions.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Screen Pied Piper Inc. (an entity in the US) against sanctions and PEP lists."; "Which sanctions lists does sanctions.io cover for the EU and the UK?"; "Check the individual Jane Doe, born 1980-01-01, against PEP and criminal watchlists.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes sanctions.io data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sanctionsio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sanctionsio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sanctionsio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sanctionsio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sanctionsio_list_sources
tools.title: List screening sources
tools.description: List the sanctions, PEP and watchlist sources that sanctions.io screens against, with their short codes. Use a short_name as data_source in sanctionsio_screen. Paginated. sanctions.io API: GET /sources/.

tools.name: sanctionsio_screen
tools.title: Screen a name
tools.description: Screen a person, company, vessel or aircraft against sanctions, PEP and criminal watchlists. Returns potential matches with confidence_score (0 to 1). A match is a lead for human review, not a final decision. sanctions.io API: GET /search/.

name.description: Full legal name (individual) or registered name (entity). At most 15 words.

entity_type.description: Type of the screened subject. Recommended: it improves match accuracy.

min_score.description: Minimum match confidence, 0.8 to 1.0. Default 0.88 (balanced); 0.93 is stricter.

data_source.description: Comma-separated collections or list codes. Collections: SANCTIONS-LISTS, PEP, CRIME, HIGH-RISK-JURISDICTIONS. Default "SANCTIONS-LISTS,PEP,CRIME". Single list codes come from sanctionsio_list_sources.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code: nationality or residence (individual), incorporation (entity).

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth, yyyy-mm-dd. Individuals only; it helps separate people with similar names.

identifier.description: One extra identifier: passport or national ID, tax ID, IMO number, aircraft registration, wallet address or company domain.

external_identifier.description: Your own reference for this subject. It is returned with the results so you can map them back.

name_match_boosting_threshold.description: Optional score, 0.93 to 0.95 recommended, that boosts strong name matches. Set too low, it adds false positives.
